_comment: issue #516 point 5 — CI ceiling baseline for tests/test_boot_context_ceiling.py. Generated by `PYTHONPATH=src py -3 -m agent_takkub.cli doctor --boot-context --project agent-takkub` (see docs/audit/2026-09-07-boot-context.md for method + why these are lower-bound estimates, NOT real billed tokens). Regenerate by re-running that command and updating the numbers below when a role file diet intentionally shrinks a role — the test fails loudly on any INCREASE past the allowance, by design. Re-baselined 2026-09-07 after #516 F1 (native_project_memory removed from every non-Lead role's report — now per-role, None until that role is respawned under its new CLAUDE_CODE_PROJECT_DIR_NAME) and F2 (chars/4 replaced by token_estimate's Thai-weighted estimator). #516b addendum (same day): the gated field is now `repo_controlled_est_tokens`/`repo_controlled_chars` — the sum EXCLUDING boot_context.DYNAMIC_STATE_CATEGORIES (learned_notes, project_memory_pointer, native_project_memory*), which are per-machine runtime state a pane's own `takkub done` writes during the day, not repo content; gating on them produced a false-positive red ceiling on a dev machine that had simply accumulated notes since the baseline was captured. `native_project_memory` below is kept for reference only (Lead's own file, measured by test_native_project_memory_measurable_not_gated as a smoke check, never gated).
